purpose: Freeze the first development-stage Qwen3-4B QLoRA raw-vs-curated comparison before running multi-step development arms.

heldout_nll.selection_rule: Sort by sha256(seed + ':' + chunk_uid), then take chunks until the token-proxy budget is reached.

external_code_guardrails.role: code capability and retention guardrail; not a selector signal

practical_effect_margin.curated_vs_raw_random_required_direction: curated mean NLL must be lower than raw-random mean NLL unless the difference is below the precomputed detectable-effect floor
practical_effect_margin.seed_aggregation: paired by the same five development seeds; report every seed and arithmetic mean
practical_effect_margin.decision_note: This margin gates development promotion only. It is not a confirmatory or release rule.

promote_to_confirmatory_only_if: curated beats Stage-A-random on the frozen heldout NLL margin
curated is directionally no worse than raw-random on heldout NLL
EvalPlus development guardrails do not regress beyond the frozen margins
general retention evidence is present and passes, otherwise abstain
training completed for all frozen development seeds or the report explicitly remains a feasibility-only partial result

forbidden_uses: using Utility, benchmark outcomes, development outcomes, confirmatory outcomes, or human/LLM review labels in Stage B
changing training seeds, optimizer steps, token budget, heldout slice, benchmark split, guardrail margin, or practical effect margin after development outcomes
reading confirmatory outcomes before the development decision is frozen
using different Stage-A baselines for sensitivity arms
utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
claim_boundary: Development-plan freeze only; no model outcome, Utility result, release decision, or paper claim.
